name: agent-run
title: Agent Run
description: A brand-neutral AI agent run that thinks, calls tools against a real-seconds timer and streams a markdown answer in bursts.
useWhen: A product demo needs the beat after the prompt, where an AI agent plans, calls tools and lands on a specific answer.
The AI feature is your own, so the interface must stay brand-neutral with one accent color.
The reply is a short markdown answer with a heading, bullets, a small code block or citations that must read clearly on the final frame.
avoidWhen: The scene is a prompt being typed into a recognizable chat product: use claude-chat or chat-gpt.
The agent is a coding CLI in a terminal: use claude-code or terminal-simulator.
A single line should type itself out with no interface around it: use typewriter.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Run script
variables.description: JSON of the agent run: title, prompt, plan (list of strings), steps (name, detail, duration in seconds, icon of chart, database, search, book, globe, terminal or file, optional sources list) and answer (short markdown: heading, bullets, code fence, bold, inline code, citations like [1]).
variables.default:
{"title": "Checkout conversion drop", "prompt": "Why did checkout conversion drop last week?", "plan": ["Compare the checkout funnel with the week before", "Break the drop down by browser and step", "Check what shipped and what the error logs say"], "steps": [{"icon": "chart", "name": "Query analytics", "detail": "checkout funnel, last 7 days vs prior 7", "duration": 1.4}, {"icon": "database", "name": "Run SQL", "detail": "conversion by browser and step", "duration": 2.3}, {"icon": "search", "name": "Search logs", "detail": "Wallet payment errors on Safari", "duration": 1.1}, {"icon": "book", "name": "Read 12 sources", "duration": 3.2, "sources": ["Checkout funnel", "Browser report", "Release 4.12", "PR #2186", "webkit.org", "developer.mozilla.org", "Payments runbook", "Error log", "Incident notes", "Wallet payments guide", "Support tickets", "Status page"]}], "answer": "## Wallet payments broke on Safari in release 4.12

Checkout conversion fell from 3.4% to 2.7% last week, a 21% drop [1]. All of it comes from the payment step on Safari, 41% of checkouts [2].

- Safari conversion halved, from 3.5% to 1.8%
- Chrome and Firefox held steady at 3.3%
- 4.12 moved the card form into an iframe without `allow="payment"` [3]

```tsx
<iframe
  src={cardFormUrl}
  allow="payment"
/>
```

**Fix:** add the attribute and ship 4.12.1 today."}
